title: Tideraiders
author: voyager2005
selftext:
Working on a Pirate game where you sail, find treasure, take over islands, level up your ship and island and battle other ships!

Anyways this game feels like it's finally getting somewhere that I'm enjoying making it.

It's MMO 😎

comments.author: poookee
comments.body: That’s very cool ! Can I ask how you made the ships ?

replies.author: voyager2005
replies.body: I have been describing exactly what I wanted with Claude and having Claude revamp all the issues I found and fully rig every piece of the ship so the flag/sails all work properly and react to wind. It used around 15 Hours of Claude Max sessions to just get the one ship design down. I'll be adding more but refining the game still 😎

replies.author: poookee
replies.body: Very cool that it’s able to make this without external 3d tools, thanks for the answer

replies.author: voyager2005
replies.body: Not sure, I had it use blender headlessly

replies.author: voyager2005
replies.body: Custom Three.js driving the WebGL renderer, so it's just custom JavaScript.

comments.author: Technical_Ideal9
comments.body: Very cool, how did you get the nice water effects?

replies.author: voyager2005
replies.body: It took about 4 prompts working with Claude to get it the colors I wanted, then another 2 to get the wakes / waves to properly move with wind / ships

comments.author: SanFranLocal
comments.body:
Nice! I also had claude build a ship (fully animated). It was ok. I ended up switching out for a unity pirate pack. 

I also dove into a pirate game this week for fun. Mine is more of a life on the ship type of game. 

Drink and Play poker with the crew  
Dynamic conversations (no llm)  
Pretty atmosphere  
Silly combat that is ragdoll heavy
